deities: Ahobila Narasimha (Ugra Narasimha) — svayambhu in the rock cave
Senjulakshmi — consort (Lakshmi born in the Chenchu tribal clan)

history.dynasty: Vijayanagara — Sangama (1336-1404 CE); Tuluva-period additions in the 16th century
history.period: Cave shrine 8th-10th century (svayambhu); structural temple 14th century; 16th-century mandapa additions
history.summary: The principal and oldest of the Nava Narasimha shrines, at the top of a hill at the end of the ghat road in Upper (Eguva) Ahobilam. Its cave garbhagriha holds a svayambhu rock formation resembling Narasimha emerging from a pillar — the spot of legend where the gods cried 'Aho Bala!' (Oh, what strength!). It is one of the 108 Divya Desams sung by Thirumangai Alwar (8th century). Inscriptions run from Chalukya Kirtivarman II (744-755 CE) to Venkatapatiraya II; a Mackenzie-recorded inscription dates the mukha mandapa to 1385-86 CE under Harihara II. The complex was sacked in 1578 and, after neglect under Nizam rule, was cleaned and restored from the mid-1990s onward. Two-tier vesara vimanam over the garbhagriha with ardha, maha, vahana, kalyana and uyyala mandapas.

name: Ahobila Narasimha Swamy Temple (Upper Ahobilam)
town_description: Ahobilam is a temple town in Allagadda mandal, Nandyal district, Andhra Pradesh, set in the Nallamala hills of the Eastern Ghats. It is split into Lower (Diguva) Ahobilam, the road-accessible village base, and Upper (Eguva) Ahobilam about 8 km uphill along a ghat road, and is the centre of the Nava Narasimha pilgrimage circuit.

travel.airport: Kurnool Airport (nearest domestic); Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad (nearest international)
travel.road: Ghat road from Lower Ahobilam (Diguva) to Upper Ahobilam (Eguva), approx. 8 km; Allagadda 24 km; regular buses from Nandyal, Kurnool, Hyderabad and Tirupati

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; 3rd week of January to 3rd week of February considered ideal
visitor_information.opening_hours: 7:00 AM-1:00 PM and 2:00-7:00 PM (sources vary on the evening close, 5:30-7:00 PM — confirm locally)
